rows.Title: Unit 1 · Animal voices
1.1 Vocal warm ups & exploring voice qualities (high/low, fast/slow, whisper, etc.)
1.2 Animal sound exploration with movement and imitation
1.3 Introduce so / mi (hand signs) and two-line stave
1.4 Representing animals with classroom instruments to a steady pulse
1.5 Small-group improvisation/composition and short class performance
1.6 Reflection / assessment / portfolio evidence
Unit 2 · Water, water, everywhere
2.1 Explore water sounds and vocabulary (voice, body, objects)
2.2 Sing so/mi songs with actions (practise and consolidate)
2.3 Create soundscapes / texture building (parachute/props, layering)
2.4 Sequence and layer sounds (simple use of sequencing / organising sounds)
2.5 Listening examples (Raindrop, Vltava, Aquarium) and discussion
2.6 Performance / reflection / teacher feedback
Unit 3 · Musical food
3.1 Introduce ta, ti-ti and sh (rest); pulse awareness activities
3.2 Match rhythms to food-word syllables and chant practise
3.3 Compose simple rhythmic ostinatos and combine groups
3.4 Use pitched and unpitched instruments to perform parts (pentatonic CDEGA)
3.5 Group performance, peer feedback and refinement
3.6 Short assessment / reflection / portfolio update
Unit 4 · Light and dark
4.1 Listen and respond to light vs dark music; describe feelings
4.2 Continue ta / ti-ti / sh notation and stick notation practise
4.3 Movement responses and expressive choices to recorded music
4.4 Compose small ta/ti-ti/sh patterns (groups) and organise into 4-beat structures
4.5 Performances, class discussion on expression and dynamics
4.6 Reflection / assessment
Unit 5 · Celebration
5.1 Select and revise favourite pieces from the year
5.2 Refine songs (add pulse, simple percussion parts, harmonies)
5.3 Compose and learn short celebratory songs as a class
5.4 Rehearse performance logistics and run-throughs (groups)
5.5 Dress rehearsal / recording / final tweaks
5.6 Final performance, reflection and portfolio completion
